name: Bard
tools: Three musical instruments of your choice
equipment: (a) a rapier, (b) a longsword, or (c) any simple weapon
(a) a diplomat's pack or (b) an entertainer's pack
(a) a lute or (b) any other musical instrument

actions.name: Bardic Inspiration
actions.desc: Bonus action: an ally within 60 ft adds the die to one check, attack or save

1.name: Spellcasting
1.desc: CHA spellcaster with spells known from the bard list; any musical instrument as focus; rituals you know.

1.name: Bardic Inspiration
1.desc: Bonus action: a creature within 60 ft that hears you gets an inspiration die (d6, d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th, d12 at 15th) to add to one check, attack or save within 10 min. CHA mod uses per long rest.

2.name: Jack of All Trades
2.desc: Add half your proficiency bonus to ability checks that don't already use it.

2.name: Song of Rest
2.desc: Allies who spend Hit Dice in your short rest regain an extra 1d6 (1d8 at 9th, 1d10 at 13th, 1d12 at 17th).

3.name: Expertise
3.desc: Double proficiency in two skills (two more at 10th level).

5.name: Bardic Inspiration
5.desc: Bonus action: a creature within 60 ft that hears you gets an inspiration die (d6, d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th, d12 at 15th) to add to one check, attack or save within 10 min. CHA mod uses per long rest.

5.name: Font of Inspiration
5.desc: Bardic Inspiration returns on a short or long rest.

6.name: Countercharm
6.desc: Action: until your next turn ends, you and allies within 30 ft that hear you have advantage on saves vs frightened and charmed.

9.name: Song of Rest
9.desc: Allies who spend Hit Dice in your short rest regain an extra 1d6 (1d8 at 9th, 1d10 at 13th, 1d12 at 17th).

10.name: Bardic Inspiration
10.desc: Bonus action: a creature within 60 ft that hears you gets an inspiration die (d6, d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th, d12 at 15th) to add to one check, attack or save within 10 min. CHA mod uses per long rest.

10.name: Expertise
10.desc: Double proficiency in two skills (two more at 10th level).

10.name: Magical Secrets
10.desc: Learn two spells from any class list (at 10th, 14th and 18th level); they count as bard spells known.

13.name: Song of Rest
13.desc: Allies who spend Hit Dice in your short rest regain an extra 1d6 (1d8 at 9th, 1d10 at 13th, 1d12 at 17th).

14.name: Magical Secrets
14.desc: Learn two spells from any class list (at 10th, 14th and 18th level); they count as bard spells known.

15.name: Bardic Inspiration
15.desc: Bonus action: a creature within 60 ft that hears you gets an inspiration die (d6, d8 at 5th, d10 at 10th, d12 at 15th) to add to one check, attack or save within 10 min. CHA mod uses per long rest.

17.name: Song of Rest
17.desc: Allies who spend Hit Dice in your short rest regain an extra 1d6 (1d8 at 9th, 1d10 at 13th, 1d12 at 17th).

18.name: Magical Secrets
18.desc: Learn two spells from any class list (at 10th, 14th and 18th level); they count as bard spells known.

20.name: Superior Inspiration
20.desc: Regain one Bardic Inspiration use when you roll initiative with none left.

3.name: Mote of Potential
3.desc: Inspiration dice you give carry a mote: on a check roll the die twice and keep either, on an attack it also thunders nearby creatures (CON save), on a save it grants temp HP.

3.name: Performance of Creation
3.desc: Action: create a nonmagical Medium or smaller item worth up to 20 gp x bard level for prof-bonus hours; once per long rest or with a 2nd+ slot. Size grows at 6th and 14th.

6.name: Animating Performance
6.desc: Action: animate a Large or smaller object as a dancing item ally for 1 h; bonus action to command it; it can add its die to your inspiration. Once per long rest or with a 3rd+ slot.

14.name: Creative Crescendo
14.desc: Performance of Creation makes up to CHA mod items at once (one at full size, the rest Small or Tiny), with no gp limit.

3.name: Silver Tongue
3.desc: Persuasion and Deception d20 rolls of 9 or lower count as 10.

3.name: Unsettling Words
3.desc: Bonus action, spend inspiration: a creature within 60 ft subtracts the die from its next save before your next turn.

6.name: Unfailing Inspiration
6.desc: A creature keeps your inspiration die if the roll it added it to fails.

6.name: Universal Speech
6.desc: Action: up to CHA mod creatures within 60 ft understand you for 1 h; once per long rest or with a slot.

14.name: Infectious Inspiration
14.desc: Reaction when your inspiration die helps a roll succeed: give a free die to another creature within 60 ft (CHA mod uses per long rest).

3.name: Mantle of Inspiration
3.desc: Bonus action, spend inspiration: up to CHA mod creatures within 60 ft gain 5 temp HP (8 at 5th, 11 at 10th, 14 at 15th) and can move their speed as a reaction without provoking.

3.name: Enthralling Performance
3.desc: After a 1 min performance, up to CHA mod humanoid watchers WIS save or charmed and idolize you for 1 h; once per short rest.

6.name: Mantle of Majesty
6.desc: Bonus action: cast Command free now and each turn for 1 min (concentration); charmed creatures fail the save. Once per long rest.

14.name: Unbreakable Majesty
14.desc: Bonus action, 1 min: the first attack on you each turn needs a CHA save or must pick another target; on a success it has disadvantage on saves vs your next spells. Once per short rest.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.desc: Proficiency in three skills of your choice.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.desc: Reaction, spend inspiration: subtract the die from an attack, check or damage roll of a creature within 60 ft that can hear you.

6.name: Additional Magical Secrets
6.desc: Two spells from any class list as extra bard spells known.

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.desc: Spend Bardic Inspiration to add the die to your own ability check.

3.name: Guiding Whispers
3.desc: Guidance cantrip with 60 ft range, not counted against cantrips known.

3.name: Spiritual Focus
3.desc: Use a candle, skull, crystal ball, tarokka deck or spirit board as focus; from 6th level +1d6 to one damage or healing roll of spells cast through it.

3.name: Tales from Beyond
3.desc: Bonus action with your focus, spend inspiration: roll a Spirit Tale with your die; later an action bestows its effect on a creature within 30 ft.

6.name: Spirit Session
6.desc: 1 h ritual with up to prof-bonus willing creatures: learn a temporary divination or necromancy spell of level up to their number; once per long rest.

14.name: Mystical Connection
14.desc: Roll twice on the Spirit Tales table and pick; doubles let you choose any tale.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.desc: Medium armor and scimitar; a proficient melee weapon can be your focus.

3.name: Blade Flourish
3.desc: Attack action: +10 ft speed; once per turn on a hit spend inspiration for extra damage plus +AC (defensive), damage to a second adjacent creature (slashing), or a push of 5 + die ft (mobile).

6.name: Extra Attack
6.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

14.name: Master's Flourish
14.desc: Blade Flourish can use a d6 instead of spending Bardic Inspiration.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.desc: Medium armor, shields and martial weapons.

3.name: Combat Inspiration
3.desc: Your inspiration die can also be added to a weapon damage roll, or to AC as a reaction against an attack.

6.name: Extra Attack
6.desc: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

14.name: Battle Magic
14.desc: After casting a bard spell with your action, bonus action weapon attack.

3.name: Psychic Blades
3.desc: Once per turn on a weapon hit, spend inspiration for +2d6 psychic (3d6 at 5th, 5d6 at 10th, 8d6 at 15th).

3.name: Words of Terror
3.desc: After a 1 min private talk, a humanoid WIS save or frightened of you or another for 1 h; once per short rest.

6.name: Mantle of Whispers
6.desc: Reaction when a humanoid dies within 30 ft: keep its shadow; later an action turns it into a 1 h disguise with its casual knowledge. Once per short rest.

14.name: Shadow Lore
14.desc: Action: a creature within 30 ft that shares a language WIS save or charmed for 8 h, believing you know its darkest secret; once per long rest.
